title: Gate Initialisation versus Recurrent Dropout and Zoneout in Learning Long Dependencies: A Controlled Study of LSTM and GRU Networks on Synthetic Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.29034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dropout and zoneout are routinely added to long short-term memory (LSTM) and gated recurrent unit (GRU) networks, but, to our knowledge, their placements have not been crossed with gate initialisation in a factorial design, and it is not known whether early gradient propagation tells which runs will learn long dependencies. We trained one-layer LSTMs and GRUs on the adding problem and on delayed recall in a factorial grid of 720 runs, crossing conventional and chrono gate initialisation with up to six recurrent regulariser placements at one rate each, with pre-specified follow-ups, and recorded how sensitive the final hidden state was to the input at every lag. Because both tasks supply fresh or exhaustive training data, the study measures the regularisers' effects on optimisation and does not assess generalisation from a finite training set. translated_title: 门控初始化与循环Dropout及Zoneout在学习长程依赖中的对比：LSTM与GRU网络在合成任务上的受控研究
translated_abstract: Dropout和zoneout通常被例行添加到长短期记忆网络（LSTM）和门控循环单元（GRU）网络中，但据我们所知，它们的放置位置尚未在析因设计中与门控初始化进行交叉组合，而且早期梯度传播能否预测哪些运行将学会长程依赖也尚不清楚。我们在求和问题和延迟回忆任务上，以720次运行的析因网格训练单层LSTM和GRU网络，将常规门控初始化与chrono门控初始化同最多六种循环正则化放置位置（每种各采用一个比率）交叉组合，并进行了预先设定的后续实验，同时记录了最终隐藏状态对每个滞后位置输入的敏感程度。由于这两个任务都提供新鲜或穷尽的训练数据，本研究衡量的是正则化方法对优化的影响，而非评估有限训练集上的泛化能力。在特意选定的使常规初始化难以奏效的序列长度下，所有360次chrono初始化的运行（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过720次运行的受控析因实验，首次系统交叉比较了门控初始化方式与循环Dropout/Zoneout放置位置对LSTM和GRU学习长程依赖的影响，发现chrono初始化在困难序列长度下使全部360次运行均获得成功。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled factorial study of 720 runs, this work is the first to systematically cross gate initialisation with recurrent dropout and zoneout placements in LSTMs and GRUs, showing that chrono initialisation enabled all 360 of its runs to learn long dependencies at lengths where conventional initialisation struggles.
